name: phd-qualifier-specialization-after-four-semesters
description: Policy review round 3, P3-cse-4a-2 (DGS 2026-10-06: “Apply the handling with option A”). §4.4: "Students must complete all three components of the qualifier requirement within four (4) semesters of starting; the DGS may extend the deadline on a case-by-case basis." Entered Fall 2024, so the four semesters end with Spring 2026; no extension on record. The research qualifier passed on time; the third specialization course, CSE 60535, was taken in Fall 2026 and graded A. The qualifier used to read Complete with the completion-form reminder; now the specialization and the qualifier are Conditionally met, waiting for the DGS to confirm an extension.

detailIncludes: Completed in Fall 2026, after the four semesters (§4.4) — confirm the DGS extended the deadline
3 of 3 parts done — 1 after the deadline, waiting for the DGS
